INITIAL_EXPLORATION.name: INITIAL_EXPLORATION
INITIAL_EXPLORATION.objective: Understand how individual objects affect the detector.
guidelines: Observe detector responses as you place and remove objects
Pay attention to what changes when each object is added or removed
Notice any patterns in activation timing or sequence
With more objects, prioritize efficient exploration — focus on narrowing down which objects matter

COMBINATION_TESTING.name: COMBINATION_TESTING
COMBINATION_TESTING.objective: Discover how object combinations and arrangements affect activation.
guidelines: Test different groupings of objects on the detector
Vary not just which objects are present, but how you arrange and sequence them
Compare results across different configurations
If a configuration that should work doesn't, consider what else might matter

transitions.condition: If results are confusing, go back to singles

HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION.name: HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION
HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION.objective: Evaluate your evidence to determine the causal rule.
guidelines: What rule type best explains ALL your observations?
Which specific objects are blickets?
Are there observations that don't fit your current hypothesis?
If observations are inconsistent, consider whether factors beyond object identity might matter

transitions.condition: When you have a clear hypothesis
If hypothesis is unclear, test more combinations

VERIFICATION.name: VERIFICATION
VERIFICATION.objective: Confirm your hypothesis with targeted tests before submitting.
guidelines: Design a test that would distinguish your hypothesis from the next most likely alternative
If the test confirms, submit your answer
If the test disconfirms, reconsider your hypothesis

ORDER_TESTING.name: ORDER_TESTING
ORDER_TESTING.objective: Test whether the order of object placement affects activation. Systematically vary placement order while keeping the same objects.
guidelines: Clear detector completely before each test
Place the SAME objects in DIFFERENT orders
Record: which order activated, which didn't
Try at least 3 different orderings

MODERATOR_DETECTION.name: MODERATOR_DETECTION
MODERATOR_DETECTION.objective: The causal rule appears to have changed. Investigate what triggers rule changes and identify the new rule.
guidelines: Count how many successful activations occurred before the change
Re-test all objects individually under the new regime
Re-test combinations to identify the new rule
Consider: does the rule cycle or switch permanently?

transitions.condition: Start fresh exploration under new rule
If new rule pattern is clear

RELIABILITY_TESTING.name: RELIABILITY_TESTING
RELIABILITY_TESTING.objective: Test whether activation is probabilistic by repeating the same configuration multiple times.
guidelines: Pick one configuration that activated before
Clear and re-place the same objects 5+ times
Count activations vs non-activations
Estimate the activation probability
